descriptionHtml:
Tech Therapy is a seminar series conducted by IEEE Robotics and Automation society- UOP, for individuals who are interested in technology and innovation.
This was the 2nd program of the series. Tech Therapy 2.0 was an informative session on “Unmanned Aircrafts”. The theory behind designing and building machines that fly, aerodynamics, control methods and applications of unmanned aircraft were discussed in the session. The speaker also shared his experience of building them.
The speaker was Mr. Asiri Rajapaksha, who is a final year undergraduate student at Faculty of Engineering- UOP.
There were Q&A session afterwards.At the end the audience left with excitement, leaving great feedback.
